title: Shock: un rayo sobre alguien mojado
description: docs/combat.md § Reacciones. A bolt on someone wet is Conducción and, half the time, Shock: their next turn is lost. Staged from the fight tester by setting the state. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.cmd = id => document.querySelector('[data-command="' + id + '"] .command-trigger').click(); window.closeUp = (id, d) => { const p = window.gerard.game.fighterAt(id); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: p.x, y: p.y, z: p.z }, d || 3.4); };

steps.caption: A cell in Shock: the bolt over its plate, until its next turn is lost
And one of the party in Shock, on their plate
The cell's turn comes and passes: «sigue en shock: pierde el turno»
Next round: whoever of the party was in Shock sits it out, the other chooses
